triples.subject: Alexey
triples.quote: “Don’t be ill-tempered with my brother. Leave off attacking him,” Alyosha said emphatically.

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: “Get along with you, Jesuits!” he cried to the servants. “Go away, Smerdyakov. I’ll send you the gold piece I promised you to-day, but be off!

triples.subject: Grigory
triples.quote: “Get along with you, Jesuits!” he cried to the servants. “Go away, Smerdyakov. I’ll send you the gold piece I promised you to-day, but be off! Don’t cry, Grigory.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: I’ll send you the gold piece I promised you to-day, but be off!

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: The old man persisted. He had reached that state of drunkenness when the drunkard who has till then been inoffensive tries to pick a quarrel and to assert himself.

triples.subject: Ivan
triples.quote: “But she was my mother, too, I believe, his mother. Was she not?” said Ivan, with uncontrolled anger and contempt.

triples.subject: Alyosha
triples.quote: it seemed really to have escaped the old man’s mind that Alyosha’s mother actually was the mother of Ivan too.
